Hi Alex / Samantha,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation on your latency and cost pain points for the Acme Maps inference workload. As promised, attaching the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a proposed evaluation plan so we can move this forward with clear owners and dates. High-level next steps I captured: 

- Redwood to provide: evaluation AMI, sample throughput tests, and a one-week trial config for your SREs. (Owner: Marissa)
- Acme to provide: test dataset, list of success criteria, and security/compliance contact. (Owner: Alex)
- Joint: 2-week evaluation window to validate latency and cost targets; sync cadence weekly.

Attached: Acme_MAP_v1.2.pdf, redwood-eval-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet with owners and dates).

Can you confirm the owners above and that the proposed evaluation window (Nov 9-20) works for your team? If those dates don't work, please propose alternatives and we'll adjust.

Thanks —
Marissa
